data.narrative:
Volund Manufacturing is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $12M to date. The founding team includes veterans from Anduril, Blue Origin, and Aerojet Rocketdyne. Valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 private peers (including UFORCE, Anduril, Helsing, Shield AI, and Castelion) and 2 public comparable companies.

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-progression analysis uses the $12M raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier to the next funding stage, yielding $30M. Peer-median analysis examines 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A), producing a median valuation of $400M and a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The two methods produce a wide dispersion, reflecting genuine uncertainty at the Seed stage. Blending the approaches, a triangulated range of $26M to $460M emerges, with a median of $215M. This wide band reflects tension between stage-typical valuations and peer comparables that skew substantially higher. Key uncertainties include whether Volund's executive depth and prior institutional affiliations justify peer-level valuations, the maturity of its go-to-market strategy, and near-term revenue visibility. Resolution of these factors will likely narrow valuation on the next funding event.
